_README: Selectors + keywords for reading a property's status on the PUBLIC Redfin
website (no login). Used only when PROPERTY_SOURCE=redfin.
The adapter is keyword-driven on purpose: it reads the status pill and the
page body text, then classifies from 'listedKeywords' / a 'sold on <date>'
pattern. This survives Redfin's frequent CSS class-name changes.
SAFETY: Redfin can only ADD a Sold/Listed block, never enable a text. If it
can't read confidently, the row falls back to REI BlackBook's status.

search._status: VERIFY against live Redfin. The homepage search box; first autocomplete suggestion opens the property.
search.searchInput: input[data-rf-test-id='search-box-input'], #search-box-input, input[type='search'], input[name='searchInputBox'], input[placeholder*='address' i], input[placeholder*='City, Address' i]
search.autocompleteOption: [data-rf-test-id='expanded-search-result-item'] a, .item-row a, .search-result-item a, [role='option'] a, ul[role='listbox'] li a, .autocomplete-item

status._status: VERIFY against live Redfin. statusPill is the small status label near the top of a property page.
status.noResultsMarker: text=/no results/i, text=/didn't find/i, text=/couldn't find/i, .no-results

_note: soldKeywords are handled in code by matching 'sold on <date>' / 'last sold <date>' and checking the date is within REDFIN_SOLD_WINDOW_MONTHS (default 24). Edit listedKeywords freely.
